headline: DRYDEN GOLD CRACKS PORPHYRY CODE AT MUD LAKE — 2.07 g/t Over 9.40m; All 10 Holes Return Gold in New Style of Mineralization for Gold Rock Camp
snippet: Dryden Gold (TSX-V: DRY) reported assay results from its first drill program at Mud Lake, 3 kilometres north of the Gold Rock deposit, with best hole DML-26-008 returning 2.07 g/t gold over 9.40 metres including a 32.70 g/t high-grade sub-interval over 0.50 metres at shallow depth. All 10 holes in the program returned gold mineralization hosted in quartz-feldspar porphyry — a geological setting the company describes as a new style of mineralisation for the Gold Rock Camp — confirming that Mud Lake represents a structurally distinct and potentially additive target to the existing resource.

headline: EUROPE'S FRESHEST HIGH-GRADE GOLD — AURANIA HITS 10.10 g/t OVER 4.15m AT ICELAND'S THORMODSDALUR; Epithermal System Delivers Near-Surface Intercept in 8-Hole 2026 Program
snippet: Aurania Resources (TSX-V: ARU) released first assay results from its 2026 eight-hole, 780.70-metre diamond drill program at the Thormodsdalur epithermal gold-silver project in Iceland, with hole TARU2026-05 intersecting 10.10 g/t gold over 4.15 metres from just 20.85 metres downhole, including 15.31 g/t gold over 2.40 metres. Aurania holds an option on the project through an agreement with St-Georges Eco-Mining's Iceland Resources subsidiary; the near-surface high-grade result — in a stable jurisdiction with strong title and infrastructure — is one of the more compelling European gold intercepts of 2026 and opens assay season for the remaining six holes.

headline: ASANTE GOLD DRILLS INTO BIBIANI OPEN PIT EXTENSION — Exploration Results Confirm Mineralisation Continuity Beyond Current Mine Plan at Ghana Gold Producer
snippet: Asante Gold (TSX: ASE) reported drilling results at its operating Bibiani gold mine in Ghana showing strong open pit extension potential at the Bibiani Main Pit, with drill holes confirming mineralisation continuity beyond the current resource boundary — though the company has not yet published revised tonnage, grade or mine-life estimates. Bibiani, which restarted in 2022, is one of West Africa's larger gold operations, and pit extension success would meaningfully extend its mine life and add ounces to what is already a significant gold asset.

headline: COPPER GIVES BACK MORNING GAINS — FALLS TO $13,251/T AS AI SELLOFF DEEPENS; Yangshan Physical Premium Still at Record Even as LME Futures Bleed
snippet: Copper retreated to US$13,251 per tonne on Monday as the AI-linked risk aversion that sent the metal to its worst weekly loss since March extended into a second session, with Nvidia and AI-valuation concerns reasserting after a brief morning bounce to $13,890. The divergence is now extreme: the Yangshan import premium remained near its record US$285 per tonne — a signal of genuine physical scarcity in China — while Shanghai SHFE copper inventories continued to tighten, suggesting the financial-market price action is entirely at odds with the underlying physical supply picture.

headline: INDEPENDENCE GOLD LAUNCHES 10,000m CAMPAIGN AT B.C.'s 3Ts GOLD-SILVER PROJECT — 765,000 Au-eq Oz Resource Underpins Largest Program in Project History
snippet: Independence Gold (TSX-V: IGO) commenced its largest-ever drill program at the 3Ts Gold and Silver Project in British Columbia — a 10,000-metre, multi-target campaign designed to expand and infill a current resource of 378,000 gold-equivalent ounces indicated and 387,000 ounces inferred. The program targets multiple zones at a project that has demonstrated high-grade gold and silver mineralisation in core drilling, in a province that has seen renewed junior mining investment in 2026 on the back of strong precious metals prices.

headline: LITHIUM X2 FILES NEVADA PFS TECHNICAL REPORT — 4.56 Mt LCE RESERVE AT HIGH-GRADE 3,928 ppm; Strong Project Economics Confirmed Even in Bearish Lithium Market
snippet: Lithium X2 Mining (TSX-V: LIXX) filed its NI 43-101 technical report for the Nevada North Lithium Project pre-feasibility study, confirming 218.3 million tonnes at 3,928 ppm lithium containing 4.56 million tonnes of lithium carbonate equivalent in the proven-and-probable reserve category. Nevada North stands out in a bearish lithium market for its high-grade brine concentration — 3,928 ppm is among the top-tier figures in North America — and its Nevada jurisdiction, which carries significant political weight for US critical minerals supply chain goals at a time when Citi is cutting lithium price forecasts to US$12,000/t.

headline: BONTERRA FORMALISES BARRY'S C$665M VALUE — 43-101 Technical Report Filed for Quebec Gold PEA With 54% IRR and 1.63 Moz M&I Resource
snippet: Bonterra Resources (TSX-V: BTR) filed its NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Barry Open Pit and Underground Gold Project in Quebec's Urban-Barry Camp, completing the formal documentation for a preliminary economic assessment that showed a C$665 million after-tax NPV5% and 54% internal rate of return at a US$3,500 per ounce long-term gold price. With initial capital estimated at C$118.7 million and a measured-and-indicated resource of 1.63 million ounces, Barry is shaping up as one of Quebec's most significant undeveloped gold assets — and a potential catalyst for M&A activity in a province with strong infrastructure and permitting precedents.

headline: METALS CREEK OPENS NEW OGDEN DRILL SEASON WITH VISIBLE GOLD — First Diamond Hole Cuts High-Grade Structure in Timmins Gold Camp; Assays Pending
snippet: Metals Creek Resources (TSX-V: MEK) reported encouraging visible gold observations in the first diamond drill hole of a new program at the Ogden Gold Project in Timmins, Ontario, with drilling ongoing and assays pending. Visible gold in drill core is a qualitative indicator of mineralisation, not a grade; previous Ogden drilling has returned intervals including 115.51 g/t gold over 9.85 metres and 40.61 g/t over 2.60 metres, establishing the high-grade context for interpreting today's sighting. The company's 50/50 joint venture partner Discovery Mining shares the program.

headline: MINING AMERICAS Q3: COPPERSTONE AND GOLD ROCK RESOURCE ESTIMATES COMING IN Q4 — Management Sets Up Year-End Catalyst Calendar for Arizona and Nevada Assets
snippet: Mining Americas reported its third-quarter 2026 results and flagged that updated open-pit resource estimates for the Copperstone gold project in Arizona and the Gold Rock gold project in Nevada are both targeted for Q4 2026. The two resource estimates represent the key near-term catalysts for the company and would position both projects for development decisions in 2027; Gold Rock in particular sits in the same Nevada basin as several large advanced gold projects that have attracted major-company attention in recent years.

headline: CRUX INVESTOR: GOLD'S SELLOFF FROM $5,500 IS "STRENGTH NOT SURRENDER" — Hosts Plan to Deploy Capital in Phases as Producer Earnings Open; Q1 Seasonality Sets Up Year-End Rally
snippet: Crux Investor argues the sharp pullback in gold from above US$5,500 to the current ~$3,879 level is consistent with mid-bull market consolidation rather than a cycle top, with the host planning to deploy capital in phases as producer earnings season gets underway. The piece frames Q1 as historically the strongest seasonal window for gold and gold equities, suggesting the binary of this week's US retail sales data and FOMC minutes represents a final near-term compression event before a year-end recovery — and that the gap between bullion prices and mining equity valuations, now 30-40% below 2026 peaks, offers leverage on any recovery.
